items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He used to come on a bandstand every night by me To get a little instruction... I'd give them a little instruction On his saxophone

ctx.x: No, that wasn't in my number I'll tell you how I got that number There was a Corporal on the police force He was playing alto sax in the police band Well, when I was playing for Bernard Michel out here During the bootlegging time Provision time He used to come on a bandstand every night by me To get a little instruction And They'd bring their music in their pocket And just ask you Say, first knock that out for me And if you play it, you was a good five or ten dollar tip So Every night you'd come sit on a…
